The price of all this reliability is a narrow tolerance.
finally: after a long time or delay; at last
After months of practice, she finally passed her driving test.
zydeco: a lively style of music from Louisiana; here part of a flower's name
Zinnia Zydeco Fire is a disease-resistant variety with fiery orange colour.
fire: the flame, light and heat produced by burning
They gathered around the fire to keep warm at night.
fiery: bright orange or red in colour, like fire
The sunset painted the sky in fiery shades of orange.
colored: The garden was filled with brightly colored flowers.
found: They found an old map hidden inside the wall.
larger: The new stadium is much larger than the old one.
those: used to refer to people or things further away or already mentioned
Those houses on the hill were built a century ago.
hope: a feeling of expectation or desire for something to happen
She never lost hope that things would improve.
list: a set of items written one after another
She made a list of groceries before going to the market.
provides: gives someone something that they need
The charity provides shelter and food for homeless families in winter.
ideas: The workshop encouraged students to share their own ideas.
planting: the activity of putting plants or trees in the ground to grow
Planting native flowers helps support local bee populations.
wherever: in or to any place that
It is dangerous wherever an effective treatment is being delayed.
